name: Perils of Salvaging (The Badlands, 2070)
description: Neon At Home's 2070 version of Salvaging Night City's tables, for the Night City of the Edgerunner's Handbook. Import this table to use your own wording: Neon At Home rolls from your copy. Edit a result's wording and Neon At Home shows yours; the peril's dice stay the module's.

results.text: The wreck you're stripping shifts and pins you. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it), and a Critical Injury to the Body.
Wraiths raid the site. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).
Fallout dust blown in from an old war site. High Level Radiation for 1d10 rounds: each, 2 damage straight to HP, as if Mildly On Fire. A Radiation Suit keeps it off.
A sinkhole opens in a dry riverbed. A 30m fall when the ground gives: 6d6 damage (armor soaks it), unless a Grapple Hand or Gun, or a DV15 Athletics Check to grab the edge, saves you.

A dust storm, and no mask. A pocket of toxic gas for a round, as a Vial of Biotoxin: beat DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs or take 3d6 straight to HP. An Anti-Smog Breathing Mask or an air supply keeps it off.
A downed AV's power cell. A live wire: electrocuted for a round, 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).
